text: Timeboxed the quick fix as instructed (~15 min): checked `nmp gen typed-decoders` (produces full decoder logic, different generated file, not a match), `nmp gen builtin-keys` (plain Rust `&[&str]`, kernel-builtin-only, no app-specific keys like `homeFeed`), and `nmp gen feed-helpers` (feed-helper code, not a key enum) against `KernelTypes.generated.swift`'s actual shape (a Swift enum mixing kernel-builtin and app-specific projection-key raw strings). None reproduce it — no clean 1:1 replacement exists among the current subcommands. So I converted the script to an explicit, loud tracked-skip: it now exits 0 with a notice pointing to chirp#37 (new issue, tracks finding the real fix) and nostr-multi-platform#2918 (the upstream root cause), and preserves the old chirp#24 known-drift baseline in the header comment for whoever picks up the rewrite. Not a silent weakening — the script says exactly why it's skipped and where the tracking lives.
